versions.content: Bit 7 (the most significant bit) of the NetworkState shall al- ways contain the Frames Lost state. This is a sporadic error that is not related to the source frame that is reported in the same data item, but shall not be reported in a separate data item. The Frames Lost state shall be set once to 1 after one or more source frames that passed the filters were lost because the queue of the destination bus was full or the transmission failed. Afterwards it shall be set to 0 again.
